mcqs.question: Which of the following statements correctly defines the amplitude of a sound wave?

options.A: The maximum displacement of the particles of the medium from their rest position.
options.B: The number of vibrations that occur in one second.
options.C: The time taken for one complete vibration of the particles.
options.D: The speed at which the sound travels through the medium.

mcqs.answer: The maximum displacement of the particles of the medium from their rest position.
mcqs.explanation: Amplitude is the greatest distance that particles of the medium move away from their equilibrium (rest) position during a vibration. It is unrelated to the number of vibrations per second (frequency), the time for one vibration (period), or the speed of sound. Option A correctly states this definition, while the other options describe frequency, period, and speed respectively.

mcqs.question: A tuning fork produces 256 vibrations each second. Which quantity best describes this number?
mcqs.explanation: Frequency is defined as the number of complete vibrations (or cycles) that occur per unit time, usually per second. In this case, 256 vibrations per second correspond to a frequency of 256 Hz. Amplitude refers to displacement, time period is the duration of one vibration, and wavelength is the distance between successive points of the same phase. Hence, option A is correct.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly compares the time period (T) of a sound wave with its frequency (f)?

options.A: T is the reciprocal of f (T = 1/f).
options.B: T is twice the value of f.
options.C: T and f have the same numerical value.

mcqs.answer: T is the reciprocal of f (T = 1/f).
mcqs.explanation: The time period (T) is the time taken for one complete vibration, while frequency (f) is the number of vibrations per second. They are inversely related: T = 1/f and f = 1/T. Therefore, option A correctly expresses this relationship. Options B, C, and D are incorrect because they either give a wrong mathematical relationship or claim no relationship.

mcqs.question: A musical note has a frequency of 512 Hz. What is its time period?
mcqs.explanation: Time period T is the reciprocal of frequency f: T = 1/f. For f = 512 Hz, T = 1/512 ≈ 0.001953125 seconds, which rounds to 0.00195 s. Option A matches this calculation. Option B mistakenly treats the period as equal to the frequency, option C is the reciprocal of 0.5 Hz, and option D corresponds to a frequency of about 1020 Hz, so they are incorrect.
